segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers are split: several say it absorbs well and even helps balance oiliness when used sparingly or at night, while others, including one who called it too heavy for her oily areas and said it triggered congestion, describe it as greasy or heavy, and multiple other reviewers caution it may look greasy on oily skin generally.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are the largest and most consistently positive group, many calling it their holy grail for resolving flaking, tightness and dry patches; a minority found it insufficient alone for very dry skin, with one layering oil underneath and another feeling it mostly sat on the surface without truly hydrating.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers are mostly positive, describing it as a good day-night balance or reserving it for night use, though one with oily-combination, acne-prone skin found it too heavy for her oilier areas and it led to congestion and small breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are strongly positive across the board, repeatedly reporting no reaction, calmer redness and comfortable hydration, including on skin described as rosacea-prone or eczema-prone.
segments.normal: The one reviewer with plain, balanced skin found the cream sat on top without absorbing and returned it, while two others who mention normal skin alongside another type report it working well.
segments.mature: The two reviewers who give their age, one in her mid-40s and one in her early 50s, both report positive results: reduced fine lines for one, relief for dry skin on the neck for the other.

concerns.blemishes: Reports are sharply split: several acne-prone reviewers, some pointing to a reformulation, describe cystic or fungal acne, congestion and breakouts appearing within about two weeks of use, often clearing up again within days of stopping; a comparable number of acne-prone reviewers report no breakouts at all, and a few say it calmed existing acne or helped scars heal, with several of the successful users noting they apply it sparingly or only at night.
concerns.dehydration: A large majority of reviewers, including many with dry or flaky skin, report the cream resolves dryness, flaking and dehydration effectively and describe it as the first product that finally worked; a minority say it mostly sits on the surface without truly absorbing, and one with very dry skin needed to layer oil underneath to get enough moisture.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with redness-prone or rosacea-adjacent skin report it calms redness, including one whose visible redness cleared up and another whose skin, normally red and rough in winter, showed no redness and a smoother texture after use; no reviewer reports new redness from the product.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers who describe a damaged or compromised skin barrier, including one recovering from retinol overuse, say this cream helped repair or soothe it within one to two weeks; no reviewer reports it worsening barrier issues.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers describe the cream sitting on the skin with a greasy or shiny look, especially in larger amounts or on oily skin; others, including two with oily skin themselves, say it absorbs without feeling oily and even helps keep oiliness balanced when used sparingly.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with acne says her acne scars have been healing quickly since starting the cream; no other reviewer comments on dark spots or marks.
concerns.aging: Several reviewers report a visible reduction in fine lines after regular use; one adds that lines she had attributed to aging turned out to respond to added hydration instead.
